title: Rajeev Gandhi Memorial College of Engineering and Technology
content: The official website identifies the institution as Rajeev Gandhi Memorial College of Engineering and Technology (RGMCET), Nandyal, Andhra Pradesh. The homepage says the institution was founded in 1995 and describes a 32.04-acre campus on NH-40 at Nandyal. The About page also says it was inaugurated on 09 March 1996 and separately describes a 50-acre campus. Because official pages disagree on acreage and distinguish founding from inauguration, do not state a single campus area or conflate those dates.
aliases: RGM College of Engineering and Technology

facts.official_name: Rajeev Gandhi Memorial College of Engineering and Technology
facts.campus_area_note: Conflicting figures appear on official homepage (32.04 acres) and About page (50 acres); omitted as a single answer.

title: Official RGMCET address and contacts
content: The official Contact Us page lists the location as Nerawada X Roads, Nandyal-518501, Andhra Pradesh, India. The About page lists Principal Dr. T. Jayachandra Prasad with phone +91-9440290470 and email principal.9@jntua.ac.in. The Contact Us page lists principal.9@jntua.ac.in and principal@rgmcet.edu.in in its email section. The common footer visibly displays principal.9@jntua.ac.in but its mailto target is principal@email.com; do not use that mismatched link target as a verified email. Identify contact sources/roles when presenting them.

facts.email_link_discrepancy: Common footer mailto target does not match its visible email label; do not use the link target.
